title: EHAL Telemetry-API (M1)
description: Normalized plant telemetry. Power in W; ess_soc in %; grid + = import, − = export; ess_power + = discharge, − = charge (OpenEMS-aligned).

grid_power_active.description: PCC active power in W. + = import, − = export.

ess_soc.description: Home battery State of Charge in %.

ess_power.description: Optional ESS active power in W. + = discharge, − = charge.

evcs_active_power.description: Optional EVCS charge power in W (≥ 0).
